claude_on_1: ⚠ CLAUDE CODE PAGE ENABLED (--enable-claude): whoever accesses the console drives an
claude_on_2: AI agent that RUNS COMMANDS and EDITS FILES as this user (in the repo).
help_ask_timeout: Seconds an unanswered question waits (detached) before denying
help_claude: Enable the Claude Code page (AI agent). ⚠ RUNS COMMANDS AND EDITS FILES as this user. Not enabled with --read-only. Default: off
help_claude_persist: Keep the Claude tab session alive after the socket drops (finishes the turn; re-attaches on return). Survives F5/standby/tab switch. server.py default: off; start.sh turns it on (NETOPS_UI_CLAUDE_PERSIST=0 turns it off)
help_detach_grace: Seconds an idle detached session survives before teardown
help_host: Bind (default 127.0.0.1; 0.0.0.0 = all IPs of the machine, IPv4 + IPv6)
help_https_port: HTTPS listener port (self-signed certificate, same IP). Default: HTTP port + 1000 (env NETOPS_UI_HTTPS_PORT); 0 disables. Needed for microphone/dictation by IP
help_max_sessions: Cap of live detached Claude sessions (new ones are refused beyond it)
help_no_vault_unlock: Disable unlocking the vault from the web (master password only in the terminal)
help_port: Preferred port (default 8765; falls back to a free one)
help_terminal: Enable the web terminal (PTY). ⚠ ARBITRARY COMMAND EXECUTION. Default: off
https_listener_ended: ⚠ HTTPS listener stopped: {error} — HTTP keeps working
https_off: ⚠ HTTPS by IP DISABLED ({error}) — the HTTP console keeps working.
https_off_port: ⚠ HTTPS by IP DISABLED (port {port}: {error}) — the HTTP console keeps working.
login_required: 🔒 LOGIN REQUIRED: the console asks for the vault master password before granting access.
missing_deps: ERROR: UI dependencies missing. Run: .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
net_claude_1: WARNING: with the Claude Code page enabled on this network, whoever logs in drives an agent
net_claude_2: that runs commands and edits files. Prefer an SSH tunnel/VPN. NOT enabled with --read-only.
net_plain_1: WARNING: login/vault unlock sends the MASTER PASSWORD in PLAIN TEXT over HTTP on this network.
net_plain_2: Use only behind an SSH tunnel/VPN, or start with --no-vault-unlock and unlock from the terminal.
net_term_1: WARNING: with the terminal enabled on this network, whoever logs in gets a full shell.
net_term_2: Prefer an SSH tunnel/VPN. The terminal is NOT enabled with --read-only.
net_warn_1: SECURITY WARNING: bound to a NON-loopback address — the console is reachable on the network.
net_warn_2: Access is protected by LOGIN (vault master password) when initialized. Use only on a TRUSTED network.
net_warn_3: This server can decrypt credentials and edit the inventory.
no_vault_1: ⚠ NO VAULT INITIALIZED: there is no master password, so there is NO login — the console is
no_vault_2: open to anyone who can reach this address. Initialize the vault
no_vault_3: (`python3 scripts/engine/vault/cli.py init`) to protect access with a password.
no_vault_unlock: (--no-vault-unlock: login authenticates the console but does NOT unlock the vault.)
persist_on_1: ⚠ CLAUDE TAB PERSISTENCE ENABLED (--enable-claude-persist): the session survives a
persist_on_2: socket drop (standby). Cap {max} detached sessions, grace {grace}s, question timeout {ask}s.
persist_on_3: A turn may keep running with the tab closed; when in doubt the agent ASKS.
setup_pending_1: 🔑 FIRST ACCESS PENDING: the console only shows the setup wizard (language, admin and
setup_pending_2: password), which requires the link with the token. Generate/reprint the link on the server:
terminal_on_1: ⚠ WEB TERMINAL ENABLED (--enable-terminal): whoever accesses the console gets a full
terminal_on_2: SHELL on this machine (arbitrary command execution, as this user).
